summary: The diff addresses all three requirements. REQ-1 and REQ-2 are handled via changes to ProfilePage.tsx (loose null equality, error state with retry, no-profile prompt) and useQueries.ts (useGetCallerUserProfile catches Unauthorized and returns null, query gated on actor readiness). REQ-3 is addressed in CreatePostPage.tsx (media blob encoding, text post support, navigation on success) and useQueries.ts (useCreatePost surfaces backend errors). However, no changes to backend/main.mo are present, and REQ-3 explicitly requires ensuring actor call parameters match backend expected argument types. Additionally, ExternalBlob usage in CreatePostPage uses methods like fromBytes, withUploadProgress, and fromURL that appear to be invented API surface.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure media blobs are correctly encoded and passed to the backend with actor call parameters matching the backend's expected argument types
missing_requirements.reason: No backend/main.mo changes are present to confirm parameter alignment. The diff only shows frontend-side changes with no verification that the actor call parameters now match backend expected types.

hallucinated_features.reason: CreatePostPage uses ExternalBlob.fromBytes(bytes).withUploadProgress((pct) => {...}) — a chained builder API with upload progress callback. No such API is described in the BuildRequest, backend schema, or any other file summary. This appears to be an invented interface.

hallucinated_features.description: Upload progress state (uploadProgress, isUploading) with simulated progress UI in CreatePostPage
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only asks to fix post creation failure. An upload progress indicator and uploading state UI were not requested.
